amala.p:
[Na+mala] (ti) CL=7 (A) The Blessed One, (b) Nibbana, (c) the Dhamma, (d) the Ketumala Ray. amala အ မ လ (န) [အ မ + အ လ. အ မ ဂ မ နေ၊ What? Dhan, Thi.

န+မလ pure; stainless; faultless.Pure, clean, spotless, white
a: (ကိလေသာ-ဟူသော)အညစ်အကြေး-မရှိ-ကင်း-သော၊(က)မြတ်စွာဘုရား။(ခ)နိဗ္ဗာန်။(ဂ)တရားတော်။(ဃ)ကေတုမာလာရောင်ခြည်တော်။ amala အမလ(န) [အမ+အလ။ အမ ဂမနေ၊ အလော။ ဓာန်၊ဋီ။၎၉၂။]  အဘြိုက်(လ-ချေး)။

B:

အမလ（န）
[ama+ala. ama gamane，alo. ，ṭī.492.]
[အမ+အလ။ အမ ဂမနေ၊ အလော။ ဓာန်၊ဋီ။၄၉၂။]

( n. ) the fruit of the āmalaka; Vin I 201, 29 (anujānāmi bhikkhave phalāni bhesajjāni vilaṅgaṃ … ~aṃ goṭhaphalaṃ …); Th 938 (~āni); Mp II 140, 29 (hatthe ṭhapitaṃ ~aṃ viya passantena); Pj I 146, 22 (bhikkhu bhesajjaṃ labhati harīṭakaṃ vā ~aṃ vā); — ifc see agad’-; — °- kakka , m. ( or n. ), a paste of ground āmalaka (used as a shampoo) ; Mp II 315, 27 (~ena sīsaṃ makkhetvā); — °- tumba , n. , a vessel made from an āmalaka plant ; Sp 1245, 6 ; Kkh 138, 19 ; — °- paṭṭa , °-patta 1 , m. , a covering with an āmalaka pattern ; Sv 87, 1 (paṭalikā ti ghanapupphako uṇṇāmayattharaṇo yo °-patto ti pi vuccati, Be so; Ee āmilākapaṭṭo; Ce amilātapaṭṭo; Se ālamakapatto) ≠ Mp II 293, 1 (~o); — °- patta 2 , n. , an āmalaka leaf ; S V 438, 30 ; — °- palibodha , m. , the obstacle, hindrance of āmalaka (shampoo) ; Mil 11, 10 ; — °- piṇḍa , n. , a lump of āmalaka paste (used as a shampoo) ; Mp II 315, 26 ; — °- muttā , f. , a kind of pearl from Sri Lanka ; Sp 75, 3 ; — °- vaṭṭamuttaratana , n. , a kind of pearl (round as an āmalaka fruit ? ) ; Ja V 380, 6 ( Be, Se so; Ce, Ee āmala-, prob. wr ); — °- vaṇṭika , °-vaṭṭika, °-vaṇṭaka, mfn. , the name or description of a kind of chair ; Vin II 149, 31 (~aṃ pīṭhaṃ, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce °-vaṭṭikaṃ; Sp 1217, 1 : ~-pīthaṃ nāma āmalakākārena yojitaṃ bahupādapīṭhaṃ, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce °-vaṭṭikapīṭhaṃ); Sp 1243, 28 ( Be °-vaṭṭakapīṭhaṃ; Ee, Se °-vaṇṭakapīṭhaṃ; Ce āmaṇḍakavaṇṭikapīthaṃ); Vin-vn 2884 (°-vaṭṭikaṃ); — see also āmalakī.
CPD: āmalaka , m. and n. [ ts .], emblic myrobalan, distinguished from harītaka (-ṭaka), yellow myro- balam; m. the plant = āmalaka-rukkha, āmalakī, n. the fruit and in general; anujānāmi bhikkhave phalāni bhesajjāni . . . ~aṃ, Vin l 201, 29 ; tena kho pana samayena Jīvako Komārabhacco nakhena bhesajjaṃ olumpetvā ~aṃ ca khādati pāniyaṃ ca pivati, 278, 6 ; Ps lV 147, 8 (= āmaṇḍa, q. v. ) ; among presents sent from Asoka to Tissa for his rājābhiseka mentioned Dīp Xl:34 ( quoted Sp 76, 2* ); idha pana bhikkhu bhesajjaṃ labhati harītakaṃ vā ~aṃ vā, Pj l 146, 22 ; Bhes 2:49; agadaṅgāran ti (M ll 216, 16 ) jhāma-harīṭakassa vā ~assa vā cuṇṇaṃ, Ps lV 2, 16 ; pl. ( the trees: ) ambā . . . harītakā ~ā, Ja Vl 529, 21* ; harītakā ~ā . . . phalāni dhārayanti te, Ap 17, 15 (Ap-a 218, 3 te harītakâdayo rukkhā); ( the fruits: ) . . . ambe ~āni ca (ɔ: gihīnaṃ upanāmenti), Th 938; — frequently used ( sg. and pl. ) in the expres- sion "like an āmalaka held in the hand" ( cf. sa. hastâ- malakavat) to give the impression of something quite clear or palpable; hatthatale ṭhapitaṃ ~aṃ viya sabbam ñeyyadhammaṃ passatā, Ps ll 7, 33 = lll 13, 10 ; hatthe ṭhapitaṃ ~aṃ viya passantena, Mp ll 140, 29 ; yaṃ hi kiñci ñeyyaṃ nāma sabbaṃ taṃ hatthatale ~aṃ viya passati, lt-a ll 191, 24 ; sabbaṃ ñeyyamaṇḍalaṃ hatthatale ~aṃ viya paccakkhaṃ katvā, Sadd 301, 3 ; Utt-vn 956; ~āhi, Dhp-a lV 127, 16 ; hatthagatâ~ā viya, Abhidh-av 181; — ° -matta , mfn. [ sa. -mātra], of the size of an āmalaka fruit; f.pl. kolamattiyo hutvā ~iyo ahesuṃ, ~iyo hutvā beḷuvasalāṭukamattiyo ahesuṃ (ɔ: piḷakā), S l 150, 29 = A V 170, 23 — Sn 125, 2 ; sāsapamattiyo piḷakā uṭṭhahiṃsu tā anupubbena . . . ~ā . . . hutvā, Dhp-a l 319, 9 ; muttā mahâ~iyo, Mhv XXVlll 36. — — lfc. agadâ °, badarâ ° (Ja lV 371, 25* ).
NCP: neuter | aamalaka the fruit of the āmalaka plant, the Indian gooseberry (phyllanthus emblica) See also: āmalakī

pn: Āmalakīvana. A grove at Cātumā. The Buddha once stayed there, and it was on that occasion that the Cātumasutta was preached. MN.i.456.
